files.references.sdl.yaml:
name: transformation-reference-case
nodes:
  web:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1 GiB
      cpu: 1
  peer:
    type: switch
content:
  payload:
    type: file
    target: web
    path: /opt/payload
relationships:
  loop:
    type: connects_to
    source: web
    target: web
files.collision.sdl.yaml:
name: transformation-collision-case
nodes:
  web:
    type: switch
  frontend:
    type: switch
files.nested-references.sdl.yaml:
name: transformation-nested-reference-case
nodes:
  lan:
    type: switch
  web:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1 GiB
      cpu: 1
    services:
      - port: 80
        name: http
    runtime:
      service_listeners:
        - service_listener_id: telemetry
          port: 9100
content:
  bundle:
    type: dataset
    target: web
    items:
      - name: report
entities:
  red-team:
    role: red
agents:
  red-agent:
    affiliations: [red-team]
    actions: [probe]
    operating_scope:
      - nodes.web.services.http
      - content.bundle.items.report
action_contracts:
  probe:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: probe the web service
    realization_profile: backend-declared
    fidelity_claim: records probe intent
    preconditions:
      - precondition_id: in-scope
        precondition_class: authority
        description: the web service is in scope
    effects:
      - effect_id: observed
        effect_class: observation_effect
        description: probe observation
        evidence_refs: [evidence.probe-output]
    failure_classes: [unknown]
behavior_specifications:
  probe-behavior:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    lifecycle_state: active
    participant_refs: [red-agent]
    action_contract_refs: [probe]
    authority_scope_refs:
      - nodes.web.services.http
      - nodes.web.runtime.service_listeners.telemetry
      - content.bundle.items.report
